title: workspaceSynced gate blocks client pricing persist on expired pilot
summary: On 360 Power production pilot, Mark Up edits do not persist to proposal-editable-workspace within 30s because canPersistWorkspacePayload requires workspaceSynced === true. E2e uses authorized server-sync PUT as test-only fallback.
retrievalQuestions: Why does Proposal Generator pricing not save to editable-workspace on expired pilot?
What is workspaceSynced and why does it block client persist in PG?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Client persist timeout in estimator-trust e2e or persistVia=server-sync in logs
doNot: Treat server-sync PUT in e2e as proof of product persist
Ignore workspaceSynced false when debugging save failures
proveBeforeClaiming: Client persist converges within wait without server-sync fallback
GET proposal-editable-workspace matches UI grand after edit without manual PUT
